parties.respondent: The State of GNCT of Delhi and Others

summary: Interconnected complaints under SC/ST (POA) Act, 1989; mutual allegations between trainees and training facility administrator involving harassment, animal cruelty, conspiracy; acid attack threat via WhatsApp; multiple FIRs and counter-FIRs; quashing petitions pending; no charge framed in key cases; standard: no mala fide intent established in departmental context; appeal addressed procedural misuse and parallel proceedings; findings on evidence sufficiency and bona fides.
legal_provisions_cited: Schedule Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned order allowing quashing petition set aside; case remanded for appropriate adjudication on merits.
